rounds.title: Round One — 2000s Pop Rnb and Chart
rounds.blurb: 20 questions on 2000s pop rnb and chart

questions.prompt: Which girl group had a UK number one with 'Pure Shores' in 2000?
questions.answerNote: 'Pure Shores' was taken from the soundtrack to The Beach.

questions.prompt: Who topped the UK charts in 2003 with 'Crazy in Love'?
questions.answerNote: The track featured her future husband Jay-Z.

questions.prompt: Which US singer released the 2000s hit 'Since U Been Gone'?
questions.answerNote: Kelly Clarkson won the first series of American Idol in 2002.

questions.prompt: Which artist had a 2003 UK number one with 'Where Is the Love?'
questions.answerNote: The track featured Justin Timberlake on backing vocals, uncredited.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a UK number one in 2006 with 'Crazy'?
questions.answerNote: Gnarls Barkley was the duo of Cee Lo Green and Danger Mouse.

questions.prompt: Which US star had a 2000s hit with 'Toxic'?
questions.answerNote: 'Toxic' later won a Grammy for Best Dance Recording.

questions.prompt: Which artist topped the UK chart in 2002 with 'A Little Less Conversation'?
questions.answerNote: This was a remix of a 1968 Elvis track made for a Nike advert.

questions.prompt: Which R&B star had a UK number one in 2001 with 'Angel'?
questions.answerNote: 'Angel' sampled Merrilee Rush's 'Angel of the Morning'.

questions.prompt: Which singer released 'Dirrty' in 2002 alongside Redman?
questions.answerNote: The video sparked controversy for its provocative styling.

questions.prompt: Which artist had the 2000s hit 'Rock Your Body'?
questions.answerNote: It was originally written with Michael Jackson in mind.

questions.prompt: Which R&B singer had a 2004 hit with 'Yeah!' featuring Lil Jon and Ludacris?
questions.answerNote: 'Yeah!' spent several weeks at UK number one in 2004.

questions.prompt: Which UK singer had a 2000s number one with 'Just a Little'?
questions.answerNote: Liberty X formed from rejected Popstars contestants.

questions.prompt: Which act had a UK number one in 2000 with 'Rock DJ'?
questions.answerNote: The controversial video showed Robbie stripping to the bone.

questions.prompt: Which singer topped the UK chart in 2007 with 'Umbrella'?
questions.answerNote: 'Umbrella' featured a rap verse from Jay-Z and spent 10 weeks at number one.

questions.prompt: Which act had the 2003 hit 'Ignition (Remix)'?
questions.answerNote: The 'Remix' was more popular than the original version of the song.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a 2000s hit with 'Complicated'?
questions.answerNote: Avril Lavigne was just 17 when this single was released.

questions.prompt: Which UK act topped the chart in 2009 with 'The Fear'?
questions.answerNote: 'The Fear' was Lily Allen's second UK number one single.

questions.prompt: Which group had UK hits with 'No Good Advice' and 'Sound of the Underground'?
questions.answerNote: Girls Aloud formed on the ITV show Popstars: The Rivals in 2002.

questions.prompt: Which US rapper had a 2003 UK number one with 'In da Club'?
questions.answerNote: 'In da Club' was 50 Cent's breakthrough hit, produced by Dr. Dre.

questions.prompt: Which singer had a 2000s UK number one with 'Hole in the Head'?
questions.answerNote: Sugababes topped the chart with 'Hole in the Head' in 2003.
